title: Incident Classification and Reconstruction
purpose: Reconstruct technical, clinical, workflow, privacy, cybersecurity, equity, communication, and economic incidents consistently.
notes: Synthetic example. Replace all values with authorized local evidence before institutional use.

records.Guidance: Describe the event or pattern, who detected it, and how it was classified.
records.Institutional response: Synthetic event: an interface delay produced stale scores; detected by the data-freshness monitor; technical and clinical categories.

records.Guidance: Preserve available data, source, timestamp, transformation, missingness, quality state, and recent source changes.
records.Institutional response: Preserved source messages, timestamps, transformations, completeness state, and interface history.

records.Guidance: Record model, software, threshold, interface, prompt, template, retrieval, knowledge source, and hosting versions.
records.Institutional response: Model v2.1, threshold 0.18, interface build 4.3, hosted release 11.4.

records.Guidance: Preserve score, classification, recommendation, generated content, alert, action, explanation, and uncertainty.
records.Institutional response: Risk score 0.09 based on stale observations; freshness warning was not displayed.

records.Guidance: Record recipient, information available, accept, reject, modify, ignore, escalation, rationale, workload, staffing, patient condition, and capacity.
records.Institutional response: Clinician accepted the display during peak workload; deterioration identified 18 minutes later through usual care.

records.Guidance: Record patient and service protection, containment, notification, restriction, pause, rollback, and fallback.
records.Institutional response: Paused display, activated fallback, reviewed affected encounters, and notified safety and vendor teams.

records.Guidance: Distinguish confirmed, contributing, and unresolved technical, clinical, workflow, organizational, and governance causes.
records.Institutional response: Confirmed interface-queue failure; contributing alert-design weakness; residual uncertainty about five encounters.

records.Guidance: Record action, owner, deadline, revalidation, communication, vendor or contract response, monitoring change, and effectiveness check.
records.Institutional response: Add freshness hard stop, queue monitoring, regression test, revalidation, and vendor corrective-action deadline.

records.Guidance: Record closure authority, evidence, affected records and people, residual risk, recurrence prevention, and portfolio implications.
records.Institutional response: Closed after effectiveness testing; portfolio-wide interface freshness control adopted.
